title: ACLP callback profile v1: standard messages
description: Proposed profile. Validate the generic envelope before resolving a method. StandardInvocation binds the complete standard method catalog to its parameter schemas; custom installed methods validate against their installed schemas. Success result values are narrowed by each installed integration. Semantic checks remain documented separately.

RequestId.$comment: Also enforce the 128 UTF-8 byte limit before dispatch.

Base64.$comment: Also decode and require canonical re-encoding to check padding bits.
